### Roxie Rave (G4)

**Who she is.** A pale mint-blue Earth-pony mare who helps with wardrobe and styling in **Photo Finish’s fashion entourage** when Fluttershy becomes a model. Look for her sharply swept, two-tone violet mane and blue eyes. She also turns up behind the Ponyville Day Spa reception counter. [G4 character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares)

**Name and appearance.** **Roxie Rave** is an official *merchandise* name—not a name spoken on screen. Hasbro’s Wave 19 blind-bag lineup includes her as **AK**, and her collector-card text associates her with **Stella Lashes** and makeup. [Wave 19 collectibles](https://data.mlpmerch.com/blind-bags/release/wave-19) Her mark in the show is three blue-and-yellow shapes interpreted as wrapped candies or bows; it resembles Sweetie Drops’s mark. **“Roxy Rave”** is a spelling used on some fan art, not a verified second in-story identity.

**Appearances and voice.** Identified in **“Green Isn’t Your Color”** (S1E20), **“A Friend in Deed”** (S2E18), and **“Equestria Games”** (S4E24), plus a background appearance in IDW *Friendship Is Magic* **#46**, page 5. [Comic issue/credits](https://comicvine.gamespot.com/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic-46-election-par/4000-551089/) No individually identifiable spoken dialogue or confirmed voice-actor credit was found. No verified disguise or alter ego.
